Yɛmpɛ sɛ yɛka kyerɛ wo, yɛmpɛ sɛ yɛka kyerɛ wo, (sɛ nea yɛrebɛka no yɛ nokware)

SƐNE AHODI KƆRƐE AMANMU NO

Aberewa bi a yɛfrɛ no Kwasi Gyaba ne ne yere kɔɔ kampu bi mu kɔɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ abɔdeɛ. Enti, berɛ a Kwasi Gyaba kɔɔ kwaa mu no, wanna nam biara. Wannna nam biara aba.

Da koro bi, ne yere bisaa no sɛ, "Me tie sɛ, sɛ woyɛ nam a, wokwata so kɔtɔn, na wo-di (sika no) anaasɛ woma nnipa adeɛ, enti nnɛ, sɛ wokɔ kwaa na wo-nsan mma nam a, mɛkɔ me maame hɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ no, efisɛ m'ayɛ m'ani mmu a mɛdi okuro, ne nsuo nam, ne nnam-nnam, ne teaseɛ." Ɔyerefoɔ no, Kwasi Gyaba, kɔɔ kwaa. Ɔhunuu duyker bi a ɔrepɛpɛ kɔ. Ɔkaa (ne ho), "Duyker, baabi a wobɛda no, ɛhɔ mɛduru wo." Duyker no kɔtoo dua bi ase. Ɔyɛyɛn (ɔyɛyɛn no) kɔtwee asuofuo no, pam! Python bi—baabi a ɛfiri no Onyame nkoaa nim—tɔɔ Duyker no so, na Leopard bi nso tuu ho. Ɔyɛyɛn no tena hɔ yɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ na ɔyɛ komm. Ɔkaa (ne ho), "Aane!" "amanehunu bɛn na meahu." Python no see sɛ, "Agya abɔdeɛfoɔ, bra, nea ti baako resumadwen, ti baako foforo nso ayɛ no adwene wɔ mmerɛ bi, enti, abɔdeɛfoɔ, bra ha, na yɛnkɔ yɛn akuraa mu, na yɛmmua saa duyker yi, efisɛ yɛrenye wo obiamu biara." Abɔdeɛfoɔ no faa ne gun no na ɔkɔɔ wɔn akyi. Wɔnkɔɔ na wɔkyekyee nnam no. Python no see sɛ, "Agya abɔdeɛ-abɔfo, mepɛ wo, enti kɔda ha nnɛ, na mɛma wo aduro; se wo hyɛ aduro yi wo nkraso mu a, wobɛte nnua ne ntudeɛ ne nsusuom nyinaa nne, ne mmoa nyinaa kasa. Enti kɔda anadwo yi, nanso mma wo honhom mmpue." Abɔdeɛ-abɔfo no kɔdae; ɔgyaeɛ ne honhom pue. Python no faa aduro no hyɛɛ ne nkraso mu. Anɔpa a ɛba no, berɛ a nneɛma nyinaa huu no, ɔyadeɛfoɔ no tee nneɛma nyinaa kasa. Ɔkɔɔ, na ɔbaa ne kuro mu. Berɛ a ɔbaa no, ɔtee sɛ ne nanten-mmaa (ne yere maame) aba ne baa (fie) hɔ. Saa ne nanten-mmaa yi, ne nananom animu yɛ kɔkɔɔ wɔ ne nananom nananom n'ani nton hɔ. Ɔyadeɛfoɔ no kɔɔ na ɔtwɛɛ mu wɔ dan no mu. Afei, kasa ne ne nka (ye. (Me werɛ fii sɛ mɛka), ɔse sɛ berɛ a ɔhyiaa ne ase-yɛfoɔ no, na ɔrepow aburo. Ɔbɔadeɛ no tenaa hɔ wɔ komm mu, na akoko mmienu a wɔbea hɔ no (hyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ wɔreka asɛm); baako bisaa ne yɔnko no sɛ, "Wo kyerɛ m'ani sɛ wo gye aburo no sɛn, nanso sɛ me kɔ (regye no) a, ɔtu me fii hɔ?" Ɔyɛnko no hyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ, "Adɛn nti, woanhunu sɛ ne nanan n'ani nini, enti sɛ (wopɛ sɛ) wogye aburo no a, sɛ wafa ne nanan ani no a, onntumi nhu wo?" Kwasi Gyaba tee (wei); ɔtoo ne ho gu fam na ɔserewee, twe! twe! twe! Ne nkyɛn-maame see, "Ah, me ba-yere, adɛn nti na woresere me saa?" Nanso Kwasi Gyaba daa fam serewee, na ɔkɔtɔe serewee. Ɛhɔ ara na ne nkyɛn-maame kae Nyame asɛm a yɛmpɛ sɛ yɛka ho asɛm bi wɔ ne ho, ɔsee sɛ Kwasi Gyaba nnyɛ ne serewee no nsɛm nyinaa nyinara Nyame anim. 

Saa seesei mɛka na mɛwu, Kwasi Gyaba e!

Mɛkasa na mɛwu, sɛ eyi ba a, mo mmpɛ m'ase. Kwasi Mpuroko Gyaba, ɔrekɔ, sɛ eyi ba a, mo mmpɛ m'ase.

Nyame mpanyimfo no see, “Tie nnamfo no anopa.” Wɔde Kwasi Gyaba kɔɔ Nyame anim. Okyeame no sowee na ɔse, “Kwasi Gyaba, woyɛɛ wo mpanin nna wosere wo mpanin mmaa no ankasa, anaasɛ ɔretɔ nkontompo?” Kwasi Gyaba ayɛyɛɛ se, “Ɔhene, aduro bi a mede ayɛ nti, sɛ meka nea ɛma me sere no a, mɛwu.” Nyame se, “Sɛdeɛ woyɛ me abɔfoɔ nti, mɛma wo anwu.” Ne mpanin mmaa no se, “Ɔhene, ɔretɔ nkontompo, ɔresere mpo me hwɛ, enti m'ani rengye hwee a ɛnyɛ nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ nea ɛsi saa.” Ɔkasampanyin no see, “Kwasi Gyaba, woate ase?” Kwasi Gyaba hyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ, “Enti mesrɛ mo ma me mofodua, na sɛ m'awu a, tow me too mu.” Ansa na ne kasa bɛyɛ kɔm, na Akɔkɔ-saman ne Akɔkɔ-baako bi baa hɔ; na Akɔkɔ-saman no see Akɔkɔ-baako no sɛ, “Gyina hɔ na mentumi anya wo.” Akɔkɔ-baako no see, “Dɛn, wɔ nnipa yi anim?” Akɔkɔ-saman no see, “Sɛ woyɛ gyina hɔ pɛ a, mɛka asɛm a yɛamfa ayɛ kyerɛw no a ɛbɛma woatumi akɔ.” Afei Kwasi Gyaba tee saa asɛm no. Ɛnɛnɛ no ɔseɛ, “Me panin, Nyame, ma wɔn ngyae mpaeboa no tow, efisɛ m'awɔ asɛm bi a mɛka.” Nyame seɛ, “Kasa.” Kwasi Gyaba seɛ, “Meka asɛm a wɔaka sɛ yɛampɛ sɛ yɛka no, na me nantenyere anyɛ ne ba kɔ.” Mpanyimfoɔ no nyinaa seɛ, “Ɛyɛ nokware, ɛyɛ nokware, asɛm no awie.” Ɛhɔ ara na Nyame yɛɛ mmara a ɛse, “obiara, mpo sɛ ɔyɛ wo adamfo, sɛ ɔyɛ wo yaw a, s ka asɛm a yadeɛ no wɔ ne ho, anaasɛ sɛ wo yere na ɔyɛ saa, ka asɛm a yadeɛ no na gya no. Efisɛ saa na nkabom a ɛyɛ ayaw baa amansan yi mu. Akoko na yɛsuaa no.

Me nsɛm a meka yi, sɛ ɛyɛ dɛ, (anaasɛ) sɛ ɛnyɛ dɛ a, fa bi kɔ bam, na ma bi mma me.
